name: Card Swap

cardDistance.description: Horizontal offset per depth slot, in px.

verticalDistance.description: Vertical offset per depth slot, in px.

skewAmount.description: Skew per depth slot, in deg.

pauseOnHover.description: Pause the cycle while the pointer is over the stack (keyboard focus always pauses it).

a11y: Auto-rotation pauses on pointer hover (when pauseOnHover is set) and always on keyboard focus inside the stack, per WCAG 2.2.2.
A visually hidden 'Next card' button gives manual, non-time-based control and becomes visible on keyboard focus.
Cards stay in DOM order; only their --genui-card-swap-slot custom property changes, so no focus or reading-order surprises come from a swap.
Reduced motion turns off the auto-cycle entirely; the Next button still reorders the cards, instantly.
